narrationTexts: I'll look at the codebase to scope this.
finalText:
**1291 hits across 94 files. About 240 must not change.**

| Zone | Hits | Why frozen |
|---|---|---|
| `migrations/` | 61 | Applied history |
| SQL strings in `services/*/repo/` | ~150 | Live DB column |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 20 | `vendor:refresh` overwrites it |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Public contract |
| `WIRE` in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | 2 | Public JSON key |

The other ~1050 are JS names. Those rename safely.

Renaming the real column needs a new migration. `audit()` in [lib/audit.js:8](lib/audit.js:8) also emits `account_id` as a log field.
